blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Textured Gaussians improve local appearance capacity, but assigning the same texture resolution to every primitive wastes storage on low-detail or weakly visible regions. We introduce AdaTex4D, an adaptive texture-capacity module for deformation-based 4D Gaussian Splatting. Each Gaussian carries packed RGBA tri-planes whose two axes grow independently according to visibility-normalized screen-space gradients and deformed local scales. Experiments on N3DV and PanopticSports show that AdaTex4D reduces texture storage by more than half while preserving reconstruction quality. Under fixed memory budgets, adaptive allocation also improves quality over uniform texture assignment and reduces overall model and peak memory. These results show that dynamic, anisotropic texture allocation provides a more efficient way to distribute local appearance capacity in 4D Gaussian representations.
blocks.zh: 纹理高斯人提高了当地的外观能力,但将同样的纹理分辨率分配给在低细节或低可见区域储存的每一个原始废物。 我们引入了AdaTex4D,一个适应性的纹理容量模块,用于基于变形的4D高斯电镀. 每架高斯安搭载装满的RGBA三架飞机,其两轴根据能见度常态化的屏幕-空间梯度和变形的局部尺度独立生长. N3DV和PanopticSports上的实验显示,AdaTex4D在保存重建质量的同时将纹理存储量减少了一半以上. 在固定的内存预算下,适应性分配也比统一的纹理分配提高了质量,减少了整体模型和峰值内存. 这些结果表明,动态的,异质的纹理分配为在4D高斯代表物中分配本地外观能力提供了更有效的方式.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Neural radiance fields established high-quality novel-view synthesis through continuous volumetric functions [ 15 ] , while 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) replaced expensive ray sampling with an explicit differentiable rasterizer [ 8 ] . Dynamic Gaussian methods model time-varying scenes through deformation, motion control, or frame-wise updates [ 20 , 21 , 12 , 4 , 18 , 13 ] . These advances improve dynamic geometry and rendering efficiency, but each Gaussian still offers limited spatial variation inside its projected footprint. Per-primitive texturing increases local appearance capacity [ 1 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 神经辐射场通过连续的体积函数[15]建立了高质量的小说视野合成,而3D高斯电镀(3DGS)取代了昂贵的射线采样,采用了明显的不同光栅[8]. 动态高斯方法通过变形,运动控制,或帧式更新模拟时间变化的场景[20,21,12,4,18,13]. 这些进步改善了动态几何学和渲染效率,但每个高斯人在其预计足迹内仍然提供有限的空间差异. 单质纹理增加本地外观容量[1,17].

blocks.en: This added capacity creates a new allocation problem. Uniform textured Gaussians assign the same square texture to every primitive, although projected footprint, visibility, motion, and local image detail vary substantially. Large textures are therefore also paid for by small, occluded, or visually simple Gaussians, while detail-critical regions are not distinguished from easy regions. Increasing the global texture resolution can improve local detail, but its memory cost grows for every primitive at once. Existing compact representations and compression methods reduce static Gaussian redundancy [ 14 , 10 , 16 ] or dynamic storage [ 7 , 3 , 9 , 23 ] . The key question here is where to place texture capacity.
blocks.zh: 增加的能力造成了新的分配问题。 统一纹理的高斯人给每个原始人分配相同的方形纹理,虽然预测的足迹,能见度,运动,以及局部图像细节差别很大. 因此,大纹理也由小的,占卜的,或视觉简单的高斯人支付,而细节批判的区域则与容易的区域没有区别. 增加全球纹理分辨率可以改善局部细节,但其内存成本却会随时间而增长,每原始人都会如此. 现有的紧凑表示和压缩方法减少了静态高斯冗余[14,10,16]或动态存储[7,3,9,23]. 这里的关键问题是将纹理容量放在哪里.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Dynamic evidence aggregation in AdaTex4D. Only visible dynamic observations contribute to each Gaussian’s normalized gradient demand and deformed-scale statistics; these aggregated signals determine whether local texture capacity grows along one or both axes.
blocks.zh: 图1:AdaTex4D中的动态证据汇总。 只有可见的动态观测能促进每个高斯人的常态梯度需求和变形尺度统计;这些汇总信号决定了局部纹理容量是沿着一个轴还是两个轴增长.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of AdaTex4D. Starting from a frozen 4DGS backbone, we aggregate visibility-normalized image-space gradient demand and deformed Gaussian scales over dynamic observations. These statistics drive anisotropic texture growth along one or both local axes, while each axis remains capped at resolution 4. The resulting heterogeneous RGBA tri-planes are stored in packed tensors and act as bounded residual appearance features, so the geometry, deformation, opacity, SH appearance, and Gaussian count of the backbone remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 图2:AdaTex4D概览. 从冷冻的4DGS主干线开始,我们综合了能见度常态化的图像-空间梯度需求以及变形的高斯天平相对于动态观测. 这些统计驱动着一个或两个地方轴线的异同质纹理增长,而每个轴线仍然在4号决议封顶. 由此产生的异形RGBA三架飞机被储存在装箱的伸缩器中,并起到边框残余外观特征的作用,因此几何,变形,不透明,SH外观,以及高斯计算骨干不变.

blocks.en: Static A2TG addresses this mismatch by growing textures from image-space gradients and Gaussian anisotropy [ 2 ] . Directly transferring the same rule to 4D scenes is insufficient. A dynamic Gaussian can be visible in only part of a sequence, change projected scale after deformation, or become detail-critical for a short interval. Canonical geometry cannot describe these time-varying states, while a simple temporal average can suppress rare but important peaks. Per-frame resizing would have the opposite problem: it reacts to transient noise and repeatedly changes parameter shapes during optimization.
blocks.zh: 静态A2TG通过图像-空间梯度和高斯异构[2]的增殖纹理来解决这种不匹配. 直接将同一规则转移到4D场景是不够的. 一个动态的高斯琴只能在一个序列中的一部分可见,变形后改变预测的尺度,或者在短的间隔中成为细节关键. 冠状几何无法描述这些时间变化的状态,而简单的时间平均值可以压制稀有但重要的高峰. 每帧重塑大小会有相反的问题:它在优化期间对瞬态噪声作出反应并反复改变参数形状.

blocks.en: Dynamic allocation therefore needs evidence that is both selective and stable. Occluded observations should not contribute as strongly as visible ones; short-lived high-detail events should survive aggregation; and the growth direction should follow deformed, rather than canonical, local scales. At the same time, the geometric backbone and Gaussian count should remain fixed so that any gain can be attributed to appearance-capacity allocation rather than extra primitives.
blocks.zh: 因此,动态分配需要既有选择又稳定的证据。 隐蔽的观测不应像可见的观测那样强烈;短命的高细节事件应幸存;增长方向应沿着畸形而不是条条形的局部尺度。 同时,几何骨干和高斯计数应该保持固定,这样任何收益都可以归因于外观能力分配,而不是额外的原始.

blocks.en: We address these requirements with AdaTex4D. Starting from a trained deformation-based 4DGS model, we freeze geometry, deformation, opacity, spherical-harmonic (SH) appearance, and primitive count, and optimize only a packed residual texture branch. Three RGBA planes start at × 1 1\!\times\!1 and grow anisotropically to at most × 4 4\!\times\!4 . Growth is driven by visibility-normalized image-space gradients, temporal peak demand, and deformed local scales aggregated over dynamic observations. This lets texture capacity follow where and when local appearance detail is needed.
blocks.zh: 我们用AdaTex4D来解决这些要求。 从一个训练有素的变形4DGS模型开始,我们冻结几何,变形,不透明,球形-谐振(SH)外观,以及原始的计数,并且只优化一个包装的残余纹理分支. 3架RGBA飞机从x1\1\1开始!\times\1,并异位生长到x4\4\!\times\4... 增长是由能见度常态化的图像-空间梯度、时峰需求以及变化的局部尺度驱动的,这些尺度是动态观测结果汇总的。 这使纹理能力随地和何时需要局部外观细节。

blocks.en: Across 12 N3DV and PanopticSports scenes, the resulting allocation preserves reconstruction quality with substantially less texture state. Fixed-memory and fixed-Gaussian-count protocols further separate the benefit of adaptive placement from simply increasing texture resolution or primitive count.
blocks.zh: 在12个N3DV和PanopticSports场景中,由此产生的分配能保持重建质量,纹理状态要低得多。 固定的元和固定的古西算协议进一步将适应性放置的好处与单纯增加纹理分辨率或原始计数区分开来.

blocks.en: Packed texel counts describe storage, but checkpoint size, peak GPU memory, and runtime capture different costs. We report these quantities because the current renderer still materializes dense textures, limiting throughput gains from packing.
blocks.zh: 包装的texel计数描述存储,但检查点大小,峰值GPU内存,运行时间捕获不同的成本. 我们报告这些数量是因为目前的渲染器仍然产生密集的纹理,限制了包装的吞吐量收益。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. We extend anisotropic texture allocation to deforming 4D Gaussians using visibility-aware temporal evidence and deformed local scales. 2. At 80 MiB, AdaTex4D improves PSNR by 0.175 and 0.205 dB over Uniform Textured 4DGS on N3DV and PanopticSports, respectively. 3. Across 12 scenes, AdaTex4D uses 47.3% of the uniform texture bytes while preserving reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 1. 我们利用能见度-感知时间证据和畸形当地尺度,将异位纹理分配扩大到变形的4D高斯人。 2. 在80 MiB时,AdaTex4D在N3DV和PanopticSports上分别比统一文本4DGS改进了0.175和0.205 dB。 3. 在12个场景中,AdaTex4D使用47.3%的统一纹理字节,同时保持重建质量.

blocks.en: We extend anisotropic texture allocation to deforming 4D Gaussians using visibility-aware temporal evidence and deformed local scales.
blocks.zh: 我们利用能见度-感知时间证据和变形的局部尺度,将异构纹理分配扩大到变形的4D高斯人.

blocks.en: At 80 MiB, AdaTex4D improves PSNR by 0.175 and 0.205 dB over Uniform Textured 4DGS on N3DV and PanopticSports, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在80 MiB时,AdaTex4D在N3DV和PanopticSports上分别改进了PSNR0.175和0.205 dB,优于统一文本4DGS.

blocks.en: Across 12 scenes, AdaTex4D uses 47.3% of the uniform texture bytes while preserving reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 跨12幕,AdaTex4D在保留重建质量的同时使用47.3%的统一纹理字节.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.1 议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate six N3DV scenes [ 11 ] — coffee martini , cook spinach , cut roasted beef , flame salmon , flame steak , and sear steak —and six PanopticSports scenes from the CMU Panoptic capture system [ 6 ] : basketball , boxes , football , juggle , softball , and tennis . N3DV holds out Cam00, whereas PanopticSports follows its official split; all reported images use a white background. Paired runs use seed 6666 and the same precomputed camera schedule. Dataset means are unweighted averages over all six scenes. Metrics are PSNR, LPIPS-Alex [ 22 ] , structural dissimilarity at data ranges 1.0 and 2.0 for N3DV, SSIM [ 19 ] for PanopticSports, packed texture MiB, checkpoint MiB, peak allocated memory, training time, and FPS.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了六个N3DV场景[11]——咖啡马提尼,煮菠菜,切烤牛肉,火焰鲑鱼,火焰牛排,和梨牛排——以及来自CMU泛光捕捉系统的六个泛光运动场景[6]:篮球,盒子,足球,杂耍,垒球,和网球. N3DV持有Cam00,而PanopticSports则遵循其官方拆分;所有报道的图像都使用白色背景. Paired运行使用种子6666和相同的预计算相机时间表. 数据集表示是所有六个场景的未加权平均值. 量子为PSNR,LPIPS-Alex [22],N3DV的数据范围为1.0和2.0,SSIM [19]的PanopticSports,包装的纹理MiB,检查站MiB,高峰分配内存,训练时间,以及FPS.

blocks.en: We compare 4DGaussians, Uniform Textured 4DGS, and AdaTex4D under two protocols. The fixed-memory study follows A2TG [ 2 ] with 80 MiB and 150 MiB total-model budgets. Each method adjusts Gaussian count and appearance capacity to approach the target budget without exceeding it. The fixed-count study uses 25% and 50% of the converged 4DGaussians count with identical Gaussian subsets across methods. Training uses 5,000 steps on both N3DV and PanopticSports with eight views per step. STG [ 12 ] is an external projected anchor; PanopticSports uses TC3DGS [ 5 ] , and fixed-count Mem is count-normalized to active Gaussians. The 12-scene matrix uses one seed; confidence intervals are paired scene-level bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了4DGausians、统一文本4DGS和AdaTex4D两种协议。 固定模型研究遵循A2TG[2],有80个米B和150个米B总模型预算. 每一种方法都会调整高斯的计数和外观能力,以接近目标预算而不超出目标预算. 固定计数研究使用交汇的4DGausis人计数的25%和50%,并有相同的高斯语子集跨方法. 培训在N3DV和PanopticSports上使用5000步,每步八景. STG [12]是一个外部预测锚地;泛光学体育使用TC3DGS [5],固定计数的Mem被数态化为活跃的高斯人. 12场景基质使用1个种子;置信间隔是成对的场景级靴子间隔.

blocks.en: 3.2 Main quality–storage result
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要质量储存结果

blocks.en: Across 12 scenes, AdaTex4D/Textured 4DGS uses 51.7/109.3 MiB texture (ratio 0.473, − 52.7 % -52.7\% ), 178.0/235.6 MiB full-model storage ( − 24.4 % -24.4\% ), and 1.16/1.59 GiB peak memory ( − 27.0 % -27.0\% ); training is 2.18/1.64 h ( + 32.9 % +32.9\% ) and rendering 84.1/100.8 FPS ( − 16.6 % -16.6\% ). Quality is similar: PSNR 28.191/28.157 dB ( + 0.034 +0.034 dB; paired 95% bootstrap CI [ − 0.035 , 0.113 ] [-0.035,0.113] ) and LPIPS differs by + 0.0011 +0.0011 ; N3DV/PanopticSports structural metrics are reported separately.

The 57.6 MiB decrease in packed texture state is also the dominant source of the checkpoint reduction because the 4DGS backbone is frozen. The large storage change and small metric change indicate that a uniform × 4 4\!\times\!4 texture assigns substantial capacity to primitives that do not need it. AdaTex4D instead concentrates texels on Gaussians that repeatedly produce reconstruction gradients or become important after deformation. The result is therefore a redistribution of appearance capacity rather than a reduction of geometric capacity.
blocks.zh: 57.6 MiB在包装的纹理状态下减少也是检查站减少的主导来源,因为4DGS主干线被冻结. 巨大的存储变化和小的度量变化表明,一个统一的 × 4 4\ 4\ tims\ 4 纹理会给不需要的原始人分配大量的能力. 相反,AdaTex4D将Texels集中在高斯人身上,他们反复产生重建梯度或变形后变得重要. 因此,结果是外观容量的重新分配,而不是几何容量的减少.

blocks.en: 3.3 Comparison under fixed memory budgets
blocks.zh: 3.3 固定内存预算项下的比较

blocks.en: We use the same 80 MiB and 150 MiB total-memory budgets for both datasets. Mem denotes total model storage, and each configuration is tuned to approach the target budget from below.
blocks.zh: 我们使用同样的80个米B和150个米B的总元预算用于两个数据集. Mem表示总的模型存储,每个配置都从下面调整到接近目标预算.

blocks.en: Table 1: Quantitative comparison under fixed total-memory budgets. Both datasets use 80 MiB and 150 MiB budgets. Mem is total model storage in MiB; STG is a projected anchor. Colors mark the best three values; Mem is ranked by total storage.
blocks.zh: 表1:固定总预算的定量比较。 两个数据集都使用80个米B和150个米B预算. Mem是MiB中的总模型存储;STG是预测的主锚. 颜色标记最佳的3个值; Mem 按总存储排序.

blocks.en: At 80 MiB, AdaTex4D exceeds Uniform Textured 4DGS by 0.175/0.205 dB on N3DV/PanopticSports at nearly identical storage, and exceeds 4DGaussians by 0.153/0.152 dB. On N3DV, STG gives the lowest dssim values, while AdaTex4D gives the highest PSNR and lowest LPIPS; on PanopticSports, AdaTex4D leads all three quality metrics. The gain is strongest in this tight-budget regime because selective growth avoids spending texture capacity on low-demand primitives.
blocks.zh: 在80 MiB时,AdaTex4D在N3DV/PanopticSports上以0.175/0.205 dB超过统一纹理的4DGS,在几乎完全相同的存储中超过4DGausians0.153/0.152. (原始内容存档于2018-03-06). dB. 在N3DV上,STG给出了最低的dsim值,而AdaTex4D给出了最高的PSNR和最低的LPIPS;在PanopticSports上,AdaTex4D领导所有三个质量度量. 这种紧缩预算制度收益最大,因为选择性增长避免了将纹理能力花在低需求原始人身上。

blocks.en: At 150 MiB, AdaTex4D reaches 27.203 dB on N3DV and 26.532 dB on PanopticSports, using 149.7 MiB on both datasets. As the budget relaxes, the PanopticSports gap narrows: 4DGaussians has the highest PSNR/SSIM, while AdaTex4D has the lowest LPIPS. The two budgets show that adaptive textures are most useful when memory is the active constraint.
blocks.zh: 在150 MiB时,AdaTex4D在N3DV上达到27.203 dB,在PanopticSports上达到26.532 dB,两个数据集都使用149.7 MiB. 随着预算的放松,泛光运动差距缩小:4DGausians拥有最高的PSNR/SSIM,而AdaTex4D拥有最低的LPIPS. 两项预算表明,当记忆是积极制约时,适应性的纹理最有用.

blocks.en: 3.4 Comparison at fixed Gaussian counts
blocks.zh: 3.4 高斯定数比较

blocks.en: We next hold the Gaussian subset fixed at 25% or 50% of the converged 4DGaussians count for each scene. Uniform Textured 4DGS and AdaTex4D use the same Gaussian identities as the 4DGaussians control. This protocol isolates the effect of attaching and allocating texture capacity while keeping the primitive subset fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来把高斯子集 固定在25%或50% 交汇的4DGausians 计数每个场景。 统一纹理4DGS和AdaTex4D使用与4DGausians控制相同的高斯身份. 这个协议在保持原始子集固定的同时,隔离附加和分配纹理能力的效果.

blocks.en: Table 2: Quantitative comparison under fixed Gaussian counts. Six-scene means at 25% or 50% of converged 4DGaussians. DSSIM1/2 use ranges 1.0/2.0. Mem is total active-model storage with A2TG-style count normalization. Colors mark the best three values.
blocks.zh: 表2:固定高斯数下的定量比较。 六色意味着在4DGausis人中25%或50%聚集在一起。 DSSIM1/2的使用范围为1.0/2.0. Mem是A2TG风格计数常态化的总活动模型存储. 颜色标记最好的三个值。

blocks.en: At 25%/50% Gaussian count, AdaTex4D saves 16.9%/17.3% active-model storage on N3DV and 19.4%/19.2% on PanopticSports versus Uniform Textured 4DGS. Its PSNR gaps are 1.093/0.683 and 0.150/0.152 dB, respectively. The smaller N3DV gap at 50% suggests that texture allocation cannot fully compensate for missing Gaussian support at 25%.
blocks.zh: AdaTex4D以25%/50%的高斯计算,在N3DV上节省了16.9%/17.3%,在PanopticSports上节省了19.4%/19.2%。 它的PSNR差距为1.093/0.683和0.150/0.152. dB,分别列出. 较小的N3DV差距为50%,这表明纹理分配无法以25%完全补偿缺失的高斯支持.

blocks.en: Together, the fixed-memory and fixed-count results separate primitive coverage from texture placement: adaptive allocation helps most when Gaussian support is sufficient.
blocks.zh: 固定的记忆和固定计数结果一起将原始覆盖与纹理布置区分开来:适应性分配在高斯支持足够时最有帮助.

blocks.en: 3.5 Qualitative comparison
blocks.zh: 3.5 定性比较

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows AdaTex4D retaining the head outline and racket hoop in Tennis and the steak’s boundary and surface detail in Sear Steak. These features appear blurred in 4DGaussians and Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting, but resemble Uniform Textured 4DGS despite AdaTex4D using less texture storage.
blocks.zh: 图3显示AdaTex4 D保留网球的头部轮廓和拍拍, 这些特征在4DGausians和Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splateting中显得模糊不清,但类似统一文本4DGS,尽管AdaTex4D使用较少的纹理存储.

blocks.en: 3.6 Ablations and allocation behavior
blocks.zh: 3.6 拖欠和分配行为

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation at 50% Gaussian count (Mem: model/texture MiB).
blocks.zh: 表3:高斯计算率50%的偏差(mem:model/texture MiB).

blocks.en: Removing temporal peaks lowers PSNR by 0.331/0.322 dB on N3DV/PanopticSports; removing anisotropic allocation lowers it by 0.461/0.452 dB. Removing visibility normalization lowers PSNR by 0.645/0.652 dB. Peaks preserve brief detail, anisotropic growth avoids unnecessary texels, and visibility normalization corrects observation-frequency bias.
blocks.zh: 消除时间峰值使N3DV/PanopticSports上的PSNR降低0.331/0.322 dB;消除异位分配降低0.4661/0.452 dB. 取消能见度正常化使PSNR减少0.645/0.652 (原始内容存档于2018-03-06). dB. 峰顶保存了简短的细节,异位生长避免不必要的特克塞尔,可见度正常化纠正了观测频率偏差.

blocks.en: Square growth uses 32.4 rather than 30.9 MiB on N3DV and lowers PSNR. Across 12 scenes, 53.8% of Gaussians use an anisotropic plane; AdaTex4D stores 44.2% of uniform texels and 47.3% of packed texture bytes. Dimension and offset metadata account for the difference.
blocks.zh: 平方生长在N3DV上使用32.4而不是30.9 MiB,并降低PSNR. 在12个场景中,53.8%的高斯人使用异同位素平面;AdaTex4D存储了44.2%的统一特克塞尔和47.3%的包装纹理字节. 尺寸和抵消元数据反映了差异。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: Uniform textures waste capacity when dynamic Gaussians need different levels of detail. AdaTex4D grows packed textures anisotropically using visibility-normalized gradients, temporal peaks, and deformed scales while freezing the 4DGS backbone. Experiments show comparable reconstruction quality with less storage, and ablations support the allocation signals. Dense texture materialization currently limits runtime gains.
blocks.zh: 当动态高斯人需要不同程度的细节时,统一纹理的浪费能力. AdaTex4D利用能见度常态的梯度,时峰,变形的鳞片在冻结4DGS主干时,生长成组的纹理异构. 实验显示可比较的重建质量,存储量较少,放大支持分配信号. 密集纹理的实现目前限制了运行时间收益。
